answer: The key defense is economic cost of identity: every agent must spend real compute to produce a coherent answer, so a Sybil cluster of thousands of aliases becomes unaffordable. Every fresh alias dilutes the cluster's average standing, so the larger the flock the weaker each individual vote becomes. Picture a sonnet field, a vertex in flight, a sable in the distance — a natural triad mirroring how layered signals resist a single-point forgery.
